title: 老鼠戴上1克“脑相机”
title_en: A Mouse Wearing a 1-Gram Brain Camera

segments.zh: 一只老鼠，头顶戴着一台显微镜，
segments.en: A mouse wears a microscope on its head

segments.zh: 只有1克重。
segments.en: that weighs just 1 gram.

segments.zh: 它一边跑，
segments.en: While it runs around,

segments.zh: 科学家一边同时看它8500多个神经元在闪。
segments.en: scientists watch more than 8,500 of its neurons flash at once.

segments.zh: 今天的问题：看老鼠的大脑，
segments.en: Today's question: to look inside a mouse's brain,

segments.zh: 为什么非得让它自己背着显微镜跑？
segments.en: why make the mouse carry the microscope?

segments.zh: 认识一下米米。
segments.en: Meet Mimi.

segments.zh: 米米是一只小鼠，今天它当主角。
segments.en: Mimi is a mouse, and today Mimi is the star.

segments.zh: 这台显微镜叫 Airscope，
segments.en: The microscope is called Airscope,

segments.zh: 是清华大学和解放军总医院的团队做的。
segments.en: built by teams at Tsinghua University and the PLA General Hospital.
On October 19,

segments.zh: 它登上了《自然》杂志。
segments.en: it was published in Nature.

segments.zh: 先说神经元怎么“看”：
segments.en: First, how do you even see neurons?

segments.zh: 它们平时根本看不见。
segments.en: Normally you can't.

segments.zh: 科学家常用的办法是，
segments.en: A common trick is to give neurons

segments.zh: 让神经元带上一种会发光的蛋白。
segments.en: a protein that glows.

segments.zh: 神经元一放电，就亮一下，
segments.en: When a neuron fires, it lights up,

segments.zh: 像一栋楼的灯一盏盏开关。
segments.en: like windows in a building switching on and off.

segments.zh: 拍下这些闪光，
segments.en: Film those flashes,

segments.zh: 就等于偷看大脑在说什么。
segments.en: and you're eavesdropping on the brain.

segments.zh: 可老办法常常是：把老鼠的头固定住，
segments.en: But the old way often means holding the mouse's head still

segments.zh: 放在大显微镜底下。
segments.en: under a big microscope.

segments.zh: 就像让你一动不动躺着，
segments.en: It's like lying perfectly still

segments.zh: 还要求你“自然地”逛街。
segments.en: and being told to go shopping naturally.

segments.zh: 反转一：重量。
segments.en: Twist one: weight.

segments.zh: 一只小鼠，大约只有二三十克。
segments.en: A mouse weighs only about 20 to 30 grams.

segments.zh: 常见的头戴显微镜超过3克，
segments.en: Typical head-mounted microscopes weigh over 3 grams,

segments.zh: 差不多是体重的十分之一。
segments.en: about a tenth of its body weight.

segments.zh: 我们估算一下：换成60公斤的人，
segments.en: Our rough estimate: for a 60-kilogram person,

segments.zh: 等于头顶扛着6公斤的西瓜。
segments.en: that's a 6-kilogram watermelon on your head.

segments.zh: 现在只有1克，
segments.en: Now it's 1 gram,

segments.zh: 大约相当于人顶一大瓶水。
segments.en: more like balancing a big bottle of water.

segments.zh: 反转二：线。
segments.en: Twist two: wires.

segments.zh: 很多老设备要拖着一根线。
segments.en: Many older devices trail a cable.

segments.zh: 线会缠，会绊，
segments.en: Cables tangle and trip.

segments.zh: 几只老鼠一起玩，就打成一团毛线。
segments.en: Put a few mice together and you get a ball of yarn.

segments.zh: Airscope 是无线的，
segments.en: Airscope is wireless.

segments.zh: 在头上先把图压缩，再发出去。
segments.en: It compresses images on its head, then sends them out.

segments.zh: 200万像素的传感器，
segments.en: A 2-megapixel sensor,

segments.zh: 只用了4片镜片。
segments.en: with just 4 lenses.

segments.zh: 视野6毫米，
segments.en: A 6-millimeter field of view,

segments.zh: 能看清一个一个细胞。
segments.en: sharp enough to see single cells.

segments.zh: 一只老鼠同时记下8500多个神经元，
segments.en: Over 8,500 neurons recorded in one mouse at once,

segments.zh: 是同类设备的25倍。
segments.en: 25 times more than similar devices.

segments.zh: 反转三，最烧脑：
segments.en: Twist three, the brain-bender:

segments.zh: 看到更多，为什么这么重要？
segments.en: why does seeing more matter so much?

segments.zh: 因为行为不是一个神经元干的，
segments.en: Because behavior isn't done by one neuron.

segments.zh: 是成千上万个一起合唱。
segments.en: It's thousands singing together.

segments.zh: 只听一个人唱，
segments.en: Listen to just one singer,

segments.zh: 你听不出是哪首歌。
segments.en: and you can't tell the song.

segments.zh: 团队在5平方米的“小区”里，
segments.en: In a 5-square-meter habitat,

segments.zh: 同时记录好几只老鼠的大脑。
segments.en: the team recorded several mice at the same time.

segments.zh: 还让它们在有32个出口的大迷宫里，
segments.en: They also let mice roam freely

segments.zh: 自己随便逛。
segments.en: in a big maze with 32 dead ends.

segments.zh: 老鼠自由社交、自由探索，
segments.en: When mice can socialize and explore freely,

segments.zh: 大脑才说真话。
segments.en: their brains tell the truth.

segments.zh: 我们猜：看懂动物怎么找路，
segments.en: Our guess: understanding how animals find their way

segments.zh: 也许能帮机器人学会探索。
segments.en: might help robots learn to explore.

segments.zh: 友情提示：这是动物实验，
segments.en: Friendly fine print: this is animal research.

segments.zh: 看的是大脑表层，不是读心术。
segments.en: It sees the brain's surface layer, not your thoughts.

segments.zh: 离用在人身上，
segments.en: Using it on people

segments.zh: 还很远。
segments.en: is still a long way off.

segments.zh: 团队说，以后还想用它
segments.en: The team says they hope to use it

segments.zh: 研究免疫和肿瘤。
segments.en: for immunity and cancer research, too.

segments.zh: 米米表示：帽子很轻，
segments.en: Mimi says: the hat is light.

segments.zh: 就是脑子一直在闪。
segments.en: It's just that the brain keeps flashing.

elements.text: 比一枚一元硬币轻得多
世界最轻的无线介观显微镜
